hypotheses: M is a literal original-coordinate physical cross block
A is real symmetric with s3(A)>=1
M=A[I,J] for disjoint physical coordinate banks I,J
claims.conclusion: After deleting only for deterministic analysis the entire I|J crossing, the remaining coefficient matrix C has ||C||op>7/8. With K=(I union J)^c, max{||A[I,I]||op,||A[J,J]||op,||A[K,K]||op,||A[I,K]||op,||A[J,K]||op}>7/40. No random term is deleted in the law.

The global third large eigenvalue need not force a lower bound on s2(M) or E3(M) inside the chosen E2 crossing. A spread target-valid family has E2(M)>1/2, E3(M)->0, s2(M)->0, while the full A has eigenvalues +L,-L,+1 of modulus at least one; the third mode can be wholly exterior. This is not a counterexample to QFORM.
On the live physical block M, e5(M^T M)>=1/1024 implies ||p_Q||infinity<=10*sqrt(2e)<23.317. Hence every unpaid packet may assume e5(M^T M)<1/1024.

first_unpaid_implication.statement: Under the original independent cap-one laws and full symmetric target s3(A)>=1, after completed E3 and D5 exits, pay the multiplicative rank-two packets above or the giant-rank-one packet together with its guaranteed >7/40 complementary physical block, retaining all coefficient tails and arbitrary same-bank curvature.
